profile_text.body:
Seagate Technology Holdings plc is a public company, traded under the ticker STX, headquartered in Singapore. Its own site describes it as a leader in mass-capacity data storage and says it has delivered more than four billion terabytes of capacity over the past four decades. The company says it makes storage that scales and that it brings trust and integrity to innovations that depend on data.

The site frames AI as a driver of data growth, saying that people and machines will create in more ways at a faster pace as AI proliferates, producing massive volumes of data. Seagate describes itself as optimizing storage for AI and making gains in capacity to support data center architecture and buildout, and it points to five strategic shifts it says can help close the gap between AI's data demands and infrastructure readiness.
